verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's workflows feature explicitly supports customized reminder/follow-up messaging tied to bookings to reduce no-shows (docs-15, docs-40, docs-48), with multi-action sequencing (docs-25) and CRM/ticket integrations via Zapier (docs-17, docs-26). However, evidence does not confirm native SMS delivery (only email/message templates are described) and no independent/hands-on verification of actual no-show reduction or reliability is present. Missing for 10: explicit SMS channel support, third-party/independent confirmation of workflow reliability and no-show impact.
